messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Next release for Stan?
parts:
Nope, CVODE is not out there which is why relasing some time soon would be great. Just to bring things wrt to dependecies on the radar which would be good to address before release (I suppose):

lib / Stan / CRAN version
boost / 1.58.0 / 1.60.0
eigen / 3.2.4 / 3.2.7

As far as I can tell this is not a problem, but an alignment is certainly better, i.e. boost 1.60.0 works with Stan, but you get a ton of deprecated messages.

Sebastian

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Next release for Stan?
parts:
On Friday, February 19, 2016 at 12:22:46 PM UTC-5, Michael Betancourt wrote:
Or interfaces expose all of the features of Stan before
working on their own specialized features...

Or make it clear what needs to be implemented. Like Bob, I didn't know there was something that needed to be done with CVODE until after the Stan release for NIPS. At that time, the main thing I was aware of that needed to be done for rstan was to enable ADVI. There was a compiler error involving cvode.h when building against the develop branch, so I built against the master branch after 2.9.0, and it was fine. The compiler error with develop is still there

https://api.travis-ci.org/jobs/110429566/log.txt?deansi=true

so I'll have to do some more stuff with the paths in order for cvode_2.8.2/ to be searched.

Ben
